title: Watermarkability: Measuring and Improving Language-Model Compatibility with Logit-Based Watermarks
abstract: arXiv:2610.22810v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model watermarks can help identify model-generated text, encode provenance information, and detect post-generation edits. A broad class of logit-based watermarks increases the logits of a designated token set at each decoding step. Because a base model's native probability mass on this set varies across contexts, models, and watermark rules, the same logit bias can yield different adherence rates and increases in perplexity (PPL). We introduce watermarkability to characterize the compatibility between a model and the token sets requested by a watermark. At a target mass $\tau$, we quantify this property through a watermarkability cost: the expected minimum KL divergence from the base-model distribution required to assign probability at least $\tau$ to the requested set. translated_title: 水印可植入性：衡量并提升语言模型与基于Logit的水印方法的兼容性
translated_abstract: 语言模型水印可以帮助识别模型生成的文本、编码来源信息以及检测生成后的编辑。一大类基于logit的水印方法会在每一步解码时提高指定词元集合的logit值。由于基础模型在该集合上的原生概率质量会随上下文、模型和水印规则的不同而变化，相同的logit偏置可能产生不同的水印依从率和困惑度（PPL）增幅。我们提出“水印可植入性”这一概念来刻画模型与水印所请求的词元集合之间的兼容性。在目标概率质量τ下，我们通过水印可植入性代价来量化这一属性：即为了使所请求的集合获得至少τ的概率，基础模型分布所需的最小KL散度的期望值。代价越低，意味着模型对该请求分布越具有可水印性。为了降低这一代价，我们提出了一种两阶段方法。在第一阶段，我们……
tldr: 该论文提出了“水印可植入性”概念及其KL散度代价度量方法，用以量化语言模型与基于logit水印之间的兼容性，并设计了降低水印植入代价的两阶段方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "watermarkability," a measure of a language model's compatibility with logit-based watermarks quantified by the expected minimum KL divergence cost, and proposes a two-stage method to reduce this watermarking cost.
